# RedRouter: Web Search

Requires `RED_ROUTER_BASE_URL` and, when the instance requires one, `RED_ROUTER_API_KEY`. See
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/reddb-io/red-router/main/skills/red-router/SKILL.md for setup.

## Discover

```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $RED_ROUTER_API_KEY" $RED_ROUTER_BASE_URL/v1/search
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $RED_ROUTER_API_KEY" $RED_ROUTER_BASE_URL/v1/models/web \
  | jq '.data[] | select(.type=="webSearch") | .id'
```

`GET /v1/search` lists the enabled search providers and the search types each supports. Web
search entries in the model list end in `/search`. Without `provider` or `model`, RedRouter picks
a configured provider and falls back to others on failure.

## Endpoint

`POST $RED_ROUTER_BASE_URL/v1/search`

| Field | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `query` | yes | 1 to 500 characters |
| `provider` or `model` | no | a provider id from `GET /v1/search`; omit to auto-select |
| `max_results` | no | 1 to 100, default 5 (clamped to the provider limit) |
| `search_type` | no | `web` (default), `news` or `x` |
| `offset` | no | result offset |
| `country`, `language` | no | locale hints |
| `time_range` | no | `any`, `hour`, `day`, `week`, `month`, `year` |
| `filters` | no | `include_domains`, `exclude_domains`, `safe_search` |
| `content` | no | `snippet`, `full_page`, `format`, `max_characters` |
| `provider_options` | no | provider-specific passthrough object |
| `strict_filters` | no | reject instead of ignoring a filter the provider lacks |

Support for individual fields varies by provider. Adding a provider key is done in the dashboard
under the provider's connection settings.

## Example

```bash
curl -X POST $RED_ROUTER_BASE_URL/v1/search \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $RED_ROUTER_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"query":"open source AI gateway","max_results":5}'
```

JS:

```js
const r = await fetch(`${process.env.RED_ROUTER_BASE_URL}/v1/search`, {
  method: "POST",
  headers: {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.RED_ROUTER_API_KEY}`,
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({ query: "latest LLM benchmarks", max_results: 10 }),
});
console.log(await r.json());
```

## Response shape

```json
{
  "provider": "<provider-id>",
  "query": "open source AI gateway",
  "results": [
    { "title": "...", "url": "https://...", "snippet": "...", "position": 1, "score": 0.92,
      "citation": { "provider": "<provider-id>", "retrieved_at": "2026-01-01T00:00:00Z", "rank": 1 } }
  ],
  "answer": null,
  "usage": { "queries_used": 1, "search_cost_usd": 0.008 },
  "metrics": { "response_time_ms": 850, "upstream_latency_ms": 700, "total_results_available": 12 },
  "errors": []
}
```
